description: Every consistent theory \(T\) in a countable language has a consistent Henkin extension in the language obtained by adjoining countably many new constants.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.consistent_henkin_extension.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [Countable L.Symbols] {T : L.Theory} (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent T) :
  ∃ H,
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.liftTheory T ⊆ H ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent H ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Henkin H
